summary: Noah Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Hong Kong Exchange monthly return for equity issuers for the month ended October 31, 2026, a routine post-listing housekeeping disclosure rather than a special situation. Authorized share capital was unchanged at 1,000,000,000 ordinary shares (par USD 0.00005; USD 50,000 total), and issued shares excluding treasury held at 343,228,815 with zero treasury shares and no movement during the month. The company confirmed compliance with the 25% minimum public float threshold. No options were granted, exercised, or outstanding under the 2022 Share Incentive Plan, though 15,760,760 shares remain available for future awards. No transaction terms, pricing, board recommendation, or advisors were disclosed.
